title: Zebra-CoT: A Dataset for Interleaved Vision-Language Reasoning
authors_zh: Ang Li、Charles Wang、Deqing Fu、Kaiyu Yue、Zikui Cai、Wang Bill Zhu、Ollie Liu、Peng Guo、Willie Neiswanger、Furong Huang、Tom Goldstein、Micah Goldblum

title: Problem
问题
html:
Text-only CoT cannot demonstrate sketching, visual search, or intermediate spatial transformations, and off-the-shelf VLMs are too weak to bootstrap such traces reliably.

Zebra-CoT serializes both textual thoughts and intermediate images so a model can learn to generate visual aids during multi-step reasoning. The decision boundary is whether a serialized record survives task answer checks, renderer consistency, domain-specific validity rules, and held-out evaluation; the direct output is Zebra-CoT, consumed by visual chain-of-thought SFT rather than an evaluation-only benchmark.

L4 facts: primary source arXiv:2507.16746; venue/date arXiv preprint (2025); open data Zebra-CoT at https://huggingface.co/datasets/multimodal-reasoning-lab/Zebra-CoT; scale 182,384 interleaved vision-language reasoning traces across 18 domains and more than 50 tasks; full paper, official README, terms, schema, and one actual record checked on 2026-07-27.

纯文字思维链无法示范画图、视觉搜索或中间空间变换，而现成视觉模型又不足以可靠自举这类轨迹。

该数据集同时序列化文字思考和中间图像，使模型学习在多步推理中主动生成视觉辅助。 判定边界是记录能否通过“任务答案检查、渲染一致性、领域有效性规则和留出评测”并成为视觉思维链监督微调的输入；直接产物是 Zebra-CoT，不是只用于评测的基准。

L4 事实：主要来源为 arXiv:2507.16746，日期与状态为 2025 年预印本；开放数据为 Zebra-CoT，规模是182384 条交错视觉语言推理轨迹，覆盖 18 个领域和 50 余种任务；已于 2026-07-27 核验全文、官方说明、条款、字段和一条实际公开记录。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Zebra-CoT serializes both textual thoughts and intermediate images so a model can learn to generate visual aids during multi-step reasoning. Relative to text-only visual-question reasoning traces, it changes the reusable target to question, text reasoning trace, final answer, problem image, and one or more intermediate reasoning images and makes task answer checks, renderer consistency, domain-specific validity rules, and held-out evaluation the feedback boundary, so the central contribution is Track 01 data rather than a model-only, verifier-only, or benchmark-only artifact.

title: Method
方法
html:
Step 1 - Source and normalize the task. Input: programmatic and curated visual tasks where sketches or intermediate images support reasoning. Operation: Normalize prompts, source identifiers, media or tools, references, and expected outputs into candidate records. Output and transition: Auditable candidates advance to target generation. Check / stop rule: Reject a candidate when its task input, source, access terms, or required reference is missing.

Step 2 - Write the reusable target. Input: A normalized candidate and its source evidence. Operation: task-specific renderers and multimodal teachers create interleaved text and intermediate images. Output and transition: The resulting answer, rationale, or tool trace is serialized as question, text reasoning trace, final answer, problem image, and one or more intermediate reasoning images and advances to verification. Check / stop rule: Stop when the target cannot be linked to its prompt, authoring mechanism, or required environment state.

Step 3 - Verify and package. Input: Generated targets and task-specific correctness metadata. Operation: Apply task answer checks, renderer consistency, domain-specific validity rules, and held-out evaluation. Output and transition: Passing records form 182,384 interleaved vision-language reasoning traces across 18 domains and more than 50 tasks stored as multi-configuration Parquet records with image assets and advance to training. Check / stop rule: Reject failed checks; final-answer agreement alone is not treated as proof that every intermediate step is correct.

Step 4 - Train and evaluate the consumer. Input: The pinned dataset revision and the paper's base checkpoint. Operation: Use the records for visual chain-of-thought SFT and compare with text-only visual-question reasoning traces. Output and transition: A trained consumer and the paper's controlled evaluation become the final artifacts. Check / stop rule: Pin the data, teacher, tools, prompts, model, seeds, and harness, and do not generalize beyond evaluated domains.

步骤 1：取得并规范任务。输入是适合草图或中间图像推理的程序化与人工整理视觉任务。操作是统一题目、来源、媒体或工具、参考信息与预期输出。输出是可审计候选，随后进入目标生成。检查与停止规则是缺少任务输入、来源、使用条款或必要参考时立即拒绝。

步骤 2：写入可复用目标。输入是规范候选及其来源证据。操作是由任务渲染器和多模态教师生成交错文字与中间图像。输出是按“问题、文字推理、最终答案、题目图像和一个或多个中间推理图像”序列化的答案、推理或工具轨迹，随后进入验证。检查与停止规则是目标无法对应题目、生成机制或必要环境状态时停止。

步骤 3：验证并打包。输入是生成目标与任务专用正确性信息。操作是执行任务答案检查、渲染一致性、领域有效性规则和留出评测。输出是通过检查的182384 条交错视觉语言推理轨迹，覆盖 18 个领域和 50 余种任务，按官方格式保存并进入训练。检查与停止规则是拒绝失败记录，且不把终答一致当作每个中间步骤都正确的证明。

步骤 4：训练并评估消费方。输入是固定版本的数据与论文基础检查点。操作是用于视觉思维链监督微调，并与只有文字的视觉问答推理轨迹比较。输出是训练后模型和受控评测。检查与停止规则是固定数据、教师、工具、提示、模型、随机种子与评测器，结论不越过已评估领域。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Decisive downstream experiment: Fine-tuning Anole-7B on Zebra-CoT improves the paper's test accuracy by 12%, while Bagel-7B gains up to 13% on standard VLM benchmarks; gains vary substantially by domain. This is evidence for the complete data intervention under the reported training setup, not proof that every released record is correct.

Artifact check: the official release contains 182,384 interleaved vision-language reasoning traces across 18 domains and more than 50 tasks and exposes actual fields question, text reasoning trace, final answer, problem image, and one or more intermediate reasoning images; on 2026-07-27 its page reported 5495 downloads. Usage is only an impact cross-check, not a causal experiment.

决定性下游实验：在 Zebra-CoT 上微调 Anole-7B 后，论文测试准确率提升 12%；Bagel-7B 在标准视觉语言基准上最高提升 13%，不同领域收益差异明显。 这只能支持论文报告训练设置下的完整数据干预，不能证明每条公开记录都正确。

产物核验：官方发布包含182384 条交错视觉语言推理轨迹，覆盖 18 个领域和 50 余种任务，实际字段是“问题、文字推理、最终答案、题目图像和一个或多个中间推理图像”；2026-07-27 数据页显示 5495 次下载。使用量只作影响交叉检查，不是因果实验。

title: Novelty
新意
html: The closest baseline is text-only visual-question reasoning traces. The paper changes the reusable object by making question, text reasoning trace, final answer, problem image, and one or more intermediate reasoning images explicit and coupling it to task answer checks, renderer consistency, domain-specific validity rules, and held-out evaluation. That is a direction signal because another team can train visual chain-of-thought SFT from the released records. The inherited backbone, source tasks, autoregressive objective, and public benchmarks are not new.
最近基线是只有文字的视觉问答推理轨迹。真正变化是把“问题、文字推理、最终答案、题目图像和一个或多个中间推理图像”显式化，并与“任务答案检查、渲染一致性、领域有效性规则和留出评测”绑定。另一团队可直接用公开记录训练视觉思维链监督微调，因此它构成数据方向信号。继承的骨干、来源任务、自回归目标和公开基准并不新。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. When rendered intermediate images may expose task templates or answer-specific cues, the most serious consequence is training on a trace whose apparent correctness does not match its reasoning; reproduce a stratified record-level audit before reuse.
  2. Because noncommercial licensing limits deployment and source media may add further constraints, downstream gains may not transfer to a new domain or deployment; run source- and domain-specific evaluations rather than relying on the aggregate score.
  3. Reuse must preserve CC-BY-NC-4.0 and every upstream source or media term; exclude records whose provenance or redistribution right cannot be reconstructed.

1. 如果渲染的中间图像可能泄露任务模板或答案线索，最严重后果是把表面正确但推理不实的轨迹用于训练；复用前应按来源和难度分层抽样复核。
  2. 由于非商业许可限制部署，上游媒体还可能附加约束，汇总收益未必迁移到新领域或部署环境；应分别运行来源级和领域级评测。
  3. 复用必须遵守 CC-BY-NC-4.0 及全部上游来源或媒体条款；无法重建来源和再分发权利的记录应排除。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
• For teams building visual chain-of-thought SFT, pin the official revision, preserve source fields, train a fixed-backbone baseline, and output both a versioned mixture and domain-level metrics. The intervention succeeds only if the target gains survive a provenance and error audit.
  • For auditors, sample records by source and difficulty and replay task answer checks, renderer consistency, domain-specific validity rules, and held-out evaluation. Produce a keep/reject ledger with failure reasons; do not use the dataset when licenses, task inputs, or verification artifacts are unavailable.

• 构建视觉思维链监督微调的团队应固定官方版本、保留来源字段、训练同骨干基线，并输出带版本的数据混合与分领域指标。只有目标收益通过来源和错误审计后，才算复用成功。
  • 数据审计者应按来源和难度抽样，重放任务答案检查、渲染一致性、领域有效性规则和留出评测，输出带失败原因的保留与拒绝台账。许可、任务输入或验证产物缺失时不应使用。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Positioning: Zebra-CoT serializes both textual thoughts and intermediate images so a model can learn to generate visual aids during multi-step reasoning.
  • Data object: 182,384 interleaved vision-language reasoning traces across 18 domains and more than 50 tasks; each record exposes question, text reasoning trace, final answer, problem image, and one or more intermediate reasoning images.
  • Author and selector: task-specific renderers and multimodal teachers create interleaved text and intermediate images; retention uses task answer checks, renderer consistency, domain-specific validity rules, and held-out evaluation.
  • Evidence anchor: Fine-tuning Anole-7B on Zebra-CoT improves the paper's test accuracy by 12%, while Bagel-7B gains up to 13% on standard VLM benchmarks; gains vary substantially by domain.
  • Reuse decision: suitable for visual chain-of-thought SFT; first audit rendered intermediate images may expose task templates or answer-specific cues and noncommercial licensing limits deployment and source media may add further constraints.

• 定位：Zebra-CoT 把文字思考与中间图像交错保存为 18.2 万条视觉推理轨迹，覆盖 18 个领域。
  • 数据对象：182384 条交错视觉语言推理轨迹，覆盖 18 个领域和 50 余种任务，单条记录包含问题、文字推理、最终答案、题目图像和一个或多个中间推理图像。
  • 生成与筛选：任务渲染器和多模态教师生成交错文字与中间图像，并依据任务答案检查、渲染一致性、领域有效性规则和留出评测保留。
  • 证据锚点：在 Zebra-CoT 上微调 Anole-7B 后，论文测试准确率提升 12%；Bagel-7B 在标准视觉语言基准上最高提升 13%，不同领域收益差异明显。
  • 复用决定：适合视觉思维链监督微调；先审计渲染的中间图像可能泄露任务模板或答案线索和非商业许可限制部署，上游媒体还可能附加约束。
